bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to employment; requiring certain information be provided to businesses when determining worker classification; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 181.725, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 181.725, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 7a.

Assistance and information for businesses; determination of worker classification.

A partnership entity must provide a requesting business with the information necessary to make a determination of the appropriate classification for an individual performing services for the business. Necessary information includes but is not limited to information regarding unemployment insurance, workers' compensation insurance, and tax identification numbers. The information must be provided by the partnership entity requested or provided in coordination with another partnership entity.
